question: Starting from the same mature particle state and the now-closed deterministic field/mover trajectory, do eduPIC and AuroraPIC produce compatible one-period stochastic collision traffic, boundary losses, populations, and electrostatic response?

basis.observed_before_declaration: The collision-free common-state trace closes through horizon 3999 with identical populations and no material field-divergence flag. Frozen-state collision-rate and collision-product audits already support the channel contracts. No collision-enabled common-state ensemble member or aggregate result has been generated or observed.

ensemble_contract.interpretation: Seeds identify independent members within each implementation; members are not paired trajectories because the generators and random-consumption patterns differ.
ensemble_contract.endpoint_alignment: eduPIC pre-push step 4000 equals AuroraPIC post-step horizon 3999

instrumentation_contract.edupic: Seed MTgen immediately after checkpoint load, count the already-selected electron elastic/excitation/ionization and ion isotropic/backward branches without adding random draws, record cumulative boundary absorption, write the pre-push-step-4000 field, and stop before that push.
instrumentation_contract.aurorapic: Use production collision diagnostics, boundary-loss diagnostics, scalar populations, and fields_3999.csv without modifying the solver.

prospective_decision_rule.integrity_gate: All source, state, gas, instrumenter, binary, rule, output-shape, finite-value, endpoint-alignment, serial-execution, and resource hashes/checks pass.
prospective_decision_rule.count_scale: For every count observable, compare ensemble means using symmetric relative difference abs(A-B)/max((abs(A)+abs(B))/2,1).
prospective_decision_rule.collision_traffic_compatible_if: Every electron elastic/excitation count differs by at most 5%; electron ionization and each ion channel differ by at most 10%. Zero-versus-nonzero for any channel fails.
prospective_decision_rule.wall_traffic_compatible_if: Each of the four species/side absorption means differs by at most 10%; if both means are below 20 events, classify that endpoint as low-count inconclusive instead of failed.
prospective_decision_rule.population_compatible_if: Each final population ensemble mean differs by at most 0.5% of the shared initial population and the signs of both mean population changes agree.
prospective_decision_rule.field_compatible_if: The relative RMS difference between ensemble-mean final electric-field profiles is at most 0.02 and the ratio of their mean field-energy proxies lies in [0.95,1.05].
prospective_decision_rule.pilot_support_if: Integrity, collision traffic, population, and field gates pass, and wall traffic has no failed endpoint. Low-count wall endpoints may remain explicitly inconclusive.
prospective_decision_rule.localized_discrepancy_if: Integrity passes but one or more substantive physics gates fail; report every failing observable without retuning tolerances.
prospective_decision_rule.inconclusive_if: Integrity fails or fewer than five valid members exist for either implementation.

claim_boundary: A passing pilot supports one-period collision-enabled stochastic consistency for this mature 1D argon CCP state. It is not seedwise trajectory identity, a steady-state Turner benchmark pass, experimental validation, a convergence proof, validation in other states/gases/dimensions, or general PIC correctness.
